tasks.title: Add one more test to Calculator test suite
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Add one new test case to the Calculator test suite covering repeated equals behavior (pressing = multiple times applies the last operation again). 2. READ FIRST: Read src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to understand existing test patterns and identify a gap. Read src/components/Calculator.tsx to confirm the repeated-equals behavior. 3. FILES: Modify src/components/Calculator.test.tsx only — no new files needed. 4. APPROACH: Add the test inside the existing 'consecutive operations' describe block. Use the same clickButtons helper and getDisplay() pattern already established in the file. The test should verify that pressing '=' twice after '5 + 3 =' produces 16 (i.e., 8 + 8). 5. PATTERNS: Follow the exact structure of the existing tests in consecutive operations describe block (lines 244-258 of src/components/Calculator.test.tsx).
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run src/components/Calculator.test.tsx exits with code 0
The new test case appears inside the 'consecutive operations' describe block
TypeScript compiles without errors: npx tsc --noEmit
